notes.title: Before Exit Gas Station is shaping up! Wishlist now!🚪
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone! 👋[/h1]

We’re super excited to share with you progres regards Before Exit: Gas Station ⛽✨

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uH6j49V.gif[/img]

If you played (and hopefully enjoyed 😉) our first game, you’ll be happy to know your beloved employee is back, this time working the late shift at a lonely little gas station. Your mission? Close everything down for the night. That means sweeping floors, cleaning toilets, restocking shelves, double-checking the workshop, shutting off the fuel dispensers… basically making sure everything is in order before heading home. Sounds simple, right? Well, not if your boss has anything to say about it - he notices every little mistake, and you’re already this close to getting fired…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863686/c14cd69b99bbabf89daf022e7463c8de87844b72.png[/img]

Like the first game, this one mixes roguelike elements, puzzles, and a chill walking-sim vibe. And for the first time in the series, you can actually step outside your workplace before calling it a day! 🌙

We’re working hard to bring you that same cozy-yet-tense feeling of the original, but with a fresh twist. And here’s a little teaser for the future: we’re developing a multiplayer mode so you can (maybe) survive those closing shifts together! More on that soon 👀


👉 If this sounds like your kind of night shift adventure, it would mean the world to us if you add Before Exit: Gas Station to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b]. It really helps us out and keeps you in the loop for updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/

Thanks for all your love and support - you’re the reason we’re able to keep making these quirky little games. 💛

[h3]Stay tuned, and don’t forget to turn off the lights before you leave 😉[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268520/Before_Exit_Gas_Station/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863686/5e689661c5818d6acd25e066da494a9b650b7773.png[/img]
[/url]

notes.title: New Content - Warehouse and Achievements
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players,[/h1].

This is the first time we have spoken to you via Steam. A strange feeling!

Some of you have already managed to play [b]"fig."[/b]. We are glad that you like the visuals and audio setting, but we also fully understand the complaints about the small amount of content.

The [b]"fig."[/b] was intended to be our side idea, born out of our love for platformers and pixel art. Emerging alongside [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1080020/Electrician_Simulator]Electrician Simulator[/url][/b], however, the small project turned out to be more than just an internal prototype. We were pleased with its form and shape, so we wanted to share this game with you!

[h3]However, not everything worked out...[/h3].

There needed to be more content. Not that there wasn't any, of course. But there was too little of it to satisfy you all. That's why we added the [b]Laboratory[/b] mode to the game a few weeks ago, which is a series of logic puzzles solved by the title character. But it doesn't stop there...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42863686/f845542f8144dff42268eae99480ecae024d35c3.png[/img]

Today we are releasing the third and final game mode! [b]Warehouse[/b] is where you will take on the enemies of the main character for a change. Enemies who have been abandoned and left for dead in the wasteland warehouse. But now they are trying to prove their worth by unlocking more passages and achieving their only goal - [b]fig. must die[/b]!

For players who like challenges, we've also added [b]Achievements[/b]. Some are simple, and some require a bit of focus and agility. Well, but who, if not you, will get them all?

And so we bring you what is probably the final version of the game [b]"fig."[/b], which is a mix and match of different ideas for characters and gameplay. We believe that you will find something to your liking in this several-hour-long, intense adventure, and you will like the world and the characters. And who knows, you may give some ideas for a bigger, full-fledged sequel.

Greetings and have fun,
[b]The Take IT Studio team[/b]!
